findings.value: A gig and club venue in a converted Victorian warehouse under railway arches in Shoreditch, with graffiti-covered tube carriages on its roof. Time Out calls it among the most atmospheric gig and club venues in London.

evidence.quote: Set underneath some cavernous railway arches
four brightly coloured, graffiti-covered tube carriages perched on its roof
which often hosts top electronic DJs and exciting up-and-coming artists

findings.value: Gigs and club nights, which Time Out says often feature top electronic DJs alongside up-and-coming artists.

evidence.quote: which often hosts top electronic DJs and exciting up-and-coming artists

findings.value: The venue says it welcomes diversity in its audience and aims to be a safe space for everyone present.

evidence.quote: We welcome diversity in our audience and work to create a safe space for everyone present
